research_question: Under a stationary but temporally persistent non-predictive portfolio process, how often does the unchanged target-1251 three-line strict gate falsely pass over the same 850 historical target outcomes?
novelty_vs_E057: E057 used independent uniform disjoint-union18 portfolios at each target; E058 uses a stationary Markov process with fixed within-line carryover to test a distinct temporally dependent null.
The process never reads target outcomes and never selects a portfolio using historical winning labels.
This is a null-calibration stress test only; it does not evaluate or promote a predictive model.

runner.runtime: Node.js-compatible deterministic JavaScript; same algorithm executed in Code Mode V8

null_process.initial_state: Uniformly sample an 18-subset from 1..45 and uniformly partition it into three labeled six-number lines.
null_process.transition: For each of the three corresponding lines, uniformly retain exactly 3 of its 6 numbers. Fill the 9 vacancies with 9 distinct numbers sampled uniformly from the 27 numbers outside the previous union18, then assign 3 additions to each corresponding line.
null_process.persistence: Exactly 3/6 numbers retained per corresponding line and exactly 9/18 numbers retained in the portfolio union at every transition.
null_process.stationarity_argument: The initial ordered partition is uniform and the transition probability is symmetric under reversing old and new partitions with the same per-line intersection sizes; the uniform ordered-partition distribution is stationary.
null_process.outcome_independence: Portfolio generation uses only its seeded PRNG and prior simulated portfolio. Target winning numbers are read only after the current portfolio is generated, solely to score the null trajectory.
null_process.target_outcomes: Canonical historical main-number outcomes for targets 401..1250, used only as fixed conditional labels; no outcome is used to generate, select, or rank a portfolio.
null_process.geometry: Exactly three pairwise-disjoint six-number lines with union18 at every target.

strict_gate.bootstrap: Two-sided percentile moving-block bootstrap on per-target differences from the frozen exact null; 17 blocks sampled independently with replacement, each block start uniform over every valid contiguous 50-target start.
strict_gate.gate_rule: All four adjusted moving-block CI lower bounds must be strictly >0 AND at least 65% of 17 non-overlapping 50-target any2-delta blocks must be positive (at least 12/17).

reporting.primary_endpoint: Empirical joint false-pass rate across 1000 persistent-null trajectories with 95% Wilson interval.
secondary_endpoints: Per-metric empirical means versus exact uniform disjoint-union18 expectations, with trajectory-level Monte Carlo standard errors.
Mean lag-1 autocorrelation of any2 outcomes under the persistent portfolio process.
Geometry, transition, source-integrity, and outcome-independence checks.
reporting.promotion_effect: None. No predictive model, candidate ranking, purchase lines, STRICT_PASS_READY, or prospective confirmation.

historical_contamination.rounds_1244_1249: Previously inspected/live-history material; not a clean holdout and not prospective confirmation.
